title: Standing Violation Points and Conduct-Complaint Disputes — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, a shopper already carrying many violation points receives a standing-points reduction in a conduct-complaint dispute.

**Clause.** The standing-points reduction looks at the account's other standing violation points, meaning the points of every recorded violation less the points of every cleared entry, the disputed violation's own recorded points left out: 11 or more take off 2 points; from 6 up to 10 (one fewer than 11) take off 1 point; fewer take off nothing.

**What the figure is.** The total points of all violation entries ever recorded on the account, less the total points of all cleared entries on the account, less the recorded points of the conduct-complaint violation under dispute. Cleared entries for expiry, for a dispute upheld or for a report not substantiated all count as cleared.

| Other standing violation points | Standing-points reduction |
|---|---|
| 11 or more | 2 points |
| 6 to 10 | 1 point |
| 0 to 5 | Nothing |

## Worked example (hypothetical account)

Recorded violations total 19 points, including the disputed conduct complaint of 4 points; cleared entries total 5 points. Other standing points are 19 less 5 less 4, that is 10 — a reduction of 1 point. Had the cleared entries totalled 3 points, the figure would be 12 and the reduction 2 points.
